svg.text: 1 • Network Architecture — Machines, Tailnet & Trust Boundaries
How Ian's fleet reaches each other: tailnet-only, least-privilege ACLs, no public Funnel, no inbound to the Box
TAILSCALE TAILNET — PRIVATE TRUST BOUNDARY • No Funnel • Tailnet-only serving
tag:grokbox • NOTHING connects inbound to grokbox
• Debian 13 • 8 vCPU Xeon • 15 GB RAM • NO GPU
• 17 Grok Bots (one shared VM, separate desktops)
• CLIs: claude • codex • hermes • swift • xtool
• Userspace tailscaled (no kernel TUN / root net)
• Atlas gate + file queue + run log (see Diag. 4)
• ⛔ NEVER run local models here (no GPU, low RAM)
MAC MINI M4 — Canonical + Apple + Local AI
• Apple M4 • 16 GB unified memory (~11.3 GiB GPU budget)
• oMLX USE: Ornith-9B = chat / cron fallback
• gemma = fast • bge-m3 = embed/RAG • TTS = speech
• Models ~104 GB: Ollama ~25 GB + HF cache ~79 GB
tailnet: omarchy-ai • heavy coding + local AI
• USE: heavy coding/builds, bulk local inference
• (Phase 1, if ACL port approved — see Diag. 4)
• Linux → NO Xcode (Apple builds stay on Mini)
• Often offline — design for async / retry
Mirror ≠ canonical • editable ≠ source of truth
• Not a tailnet member • no keys shown
Userspace Tailscale = agent VM joins tailnet without
privileged kernel networking; apps opt-in via SOCKS5.
Least-privilege ACL: Box can SSH, only Mini gets 443
for oMLX. Compromised bot ≠ full LAN access.
Tailnet-only (no Funnel) = oMLX API is never public.
M4's 16 GB is shared CPU+GPU — no PCIe VRAM copy,
but the model, OS, and apps compete for same pool.
That is why GPU budget is ~11.3 GiB, not 16 GiB,
and why only one 9B model loads at a time.
Edit ~/projects on Mini; NAS is a mirror you may
also edit — it does not become the source of truth.
Box has NO NAS path: backup access is not an
Box → Omarchy: UNVERIFIED — path/ACL not documented (machine access, not Ollama svc)
Solid = documented, verified path • Label = port + protocol + purpose
Dashed boundary = Tailscale tailnet. Anything outside needs explicit HTTPS egress.
If a line is not drawn, ACL denies it — especially: inbound → grokbox, and Box → NAS.
